question_text: What processes are used to evaluate and maintain an approved list of patches?
Utilizing your organization’s cyber incident response plan (CIRP), describe the actions that your organization would take at this time.
Describe your policies on remote access to your organization’s network.
What redundant systems exist when primary systems are compromised?
Does your CIRP include procedures to operate in manual mode if a cyber incident compromises OT systems?
What capabilities and resources are required to respond to this scenario?
Is your CIRP aligned with any OT incident response plans?
Who can authorize use of alternate systems or procedures?
What services do you use for intrusion detection monitoring?
What cybersecurity threat information does your organization receive (e.g., information from CISA, FBI, Fusion Center)?
Is there funding available to pay for credit monitoring for impacted individuals?
How is public messaging  coordinated and disseminated during a cyber incident?
How would you coordinate with your cloud service provider to investigate anomalies with cloud-based services?
How does your plan define escalation criteria, notifications, activations, and/or courses of action?
What is your role during cyber incident response?
What guidance does the plan include on assessing the severity of an incident?
How does incident severity level dictate response actions?
Describe your cybersecurity culture.
Discuss your risk management strategy.
Based on discussion, what changes would you implement to increase the resilience of your organization?
